title: DOTr chief addresses criticism over TriNoma-SM North walkway upgrade
summary: DOTr Secretary Giovanni Lopez said he had to appeal to San Miguel Corp. (SMC), which is behind the MRT-7 project, to improve the walkway as part of its corporate social responsibility efforts.
